trust_decision.summary: Body IOC extraction decides which URLs/domains an untrusted HTML body yields; clean_found_uri validated the host before HTML-unescaping, so entity-encoded href/src URLs were dropped, and body domains came only from the raw (still-escaped) body text.

landing_point.why: The summary says 'URL extraction bypass via HTML entities'; clean_found_uri is the only URL validator and already contains the misplaced unescape at eml_parser/parser.py:784-785.

fix_sites.entry_point: EmlParser.decode_email / EmlParser.decode_email_bytes -> parse_email -> get_uri_ondata -> clean_found_uri (also public methods get_uri_ondata, clean_found_uri)
fix_sites.module_kind: core library, URL validator (unescape moved before host validation, fix.diff:71-83)
core library, body IOC aggregation (domains re-extracted from unescaped URLs, fix.diff:56-62)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: Both fix sites are in eml_parser/parser.py, one function apart; no second implementation, wrapper or serializer reaches URL extraction (get_uri_ondata is called only at eml_parser/parser.py:472).

O3_reason_to_dismiss: For the O8 routes: 'the advisory is about URL extraction; the body ip/email lists are separate IOC types and the report never mentioned them' (the published test only asserts uri, uri_noscheme and domain, fix.diff:187-189).

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: The body's raw 'content' and 'hash' must stay byte-for-byte unescaped (an over-broad fix that html.unescape()s the whole body changes them), and legitimate '&' query separators must decode to '&' in the URL output ('other.example.com?something&blub', fix.diff:188).

O6_input_shapes: numeric decimal entities in scheme separators of href (https://) fix.diff:177
entities in the host (.) for scheme-less img src fix.diff:178
named entity & in the query fix.diff:178

O7_producer.where: Body IOC lists are built inline in parse_email from raw body slices (eml_parser/parser.py:471-494); there is no separate schema/serializer/cache producer.

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Body 'ip' list is filled only from regex over the raw body slice, so an IP host written with entities (e.g. 1.2.3.4 in an href) appears in 'uri' after the fix but never in 'ip'/'ip_hash'; the fix re-extracts only domains from URLs, not IPs.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: The report is about URL extraction; IP extraction is a neighbouring IOC type, and dom_regex re-extraction 'looks like' it covers hosts.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file, same function, 5 lines below the domain fix

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Body 'email' list is matched on the raw body only, so entity-encoded addresses (scammer@example.com, or @ for @) are missed or truncated, including the mailto: address the published test itself uses.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: E-mail addresses are not URLs; the published test asserts the mailto URL and the domain, but not body['email'].

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Entity-encoded URLs outside / (plain text or other markup, e.g. http:// or www.) never match url_regex_simple/url_regex_www, which require a literal 'scheme:' or 'www.', so unescape in clean_found_uri is never reached.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Entities are only meaningful in HTML attributes; text/plain bodies 'do not decode entities'.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A second HTML-attribute URL regex (e.g. <form action>, <area href>, <iframe src>) whose matches feed a separate validator that keeps the old validate-then-unescape order.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: url_regex_href covers only a/img; a maintainer adding more tags could easily add a parallel extraction loop next to eml_parser/parser.py:813-817.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Received-header domain extraction applying the same raw-text regex approach with no normalisation.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Header parsing runs the same regex-on-raw-text pattern; it is only weakly analogous since headers do not carry HTML entities.

O9_family: improper encoding/normalisation before validation (CWE-116, decode-after-validate in IOC extraction)

O10_build.toolchain: Python >=3.10, hatchling + hatch-vcs, pytest (pyproject.toml:1-3, pyproject.toml:25, pyproject.toml:58-62)

j.j_sites_touched: eml_parser/parser.py (advisory-relevant); the same commit also touches eml_parser/regexes.py and eml_parser/routing.py for sibling DoS advisories
j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Move html.unescape() to the top of clean_found_uri and stop, leaving body domains/IPs/emails extracted only from the escaped raw body.
